summary: Frontend-only Orbit rebrand + Deep Space theme verification. All 12 requested checks pass. Dark mode is the default, theme toggle persists across reload, Orbit branding is applied everywhere reachable, BDapps/Provisioning/Pro App Builder are removed from dev+admin surfaces, sidebar link sets match the spec, Digital page has exactly 2 builder tabs and a working AI compose bar, and the public App Store shows Orbit footer/brand. Zero red console errors across all tested pages.

checks_verified.login_dark_default: PASS - <html> has no 'light' class, Orbit mark + lowercase 'orbit' wordmark visible, demo creds show developer@orbit.app / admin@orbit.app
checks_verified.theme_toggle: PASS - data-testid='theme-toggle' present. Click toggles <html> class to 'light'; persists after reload; toggling back removes 'light'.
checks_verified.dev_login_dashboard: PASS - developer@orbit.app / dev123 lands on /dashboard. Module tiles include App Store, Reports, Digital, My Apps. No 'Provisioning', 'BDapps Lite', or 'Pro App Builder' text.
checks_verified.dev_sidebar: PASS - side-dashboard, side-app-store, side-reports, side-digital, side-my-apps, side-add-ons all present (count=1 each). side-provisioning count=0.
checks_verified.digital_page: PASS - 'Orbit Builder' title, tab-web + tab-android present, no 'Pro App Builder'. ai-compose-bar visible; ai-compose-input placeholder='Describe the app you want to build...' accepts typed text; 'LISTENING' badge visible.
checks_verified.my_apps: PASS - loads in dark theme, no BDapps text, no console errors
checks_verified.reports_addons: PASS - both load in dark theme, no BDapps text, no console errors
checks_verified.admin_login: PASS - admin@orbit.app / admin123 lands on /admin. Exactly 5 module tiles visible: User Management, App Store, Reporting, Tap Admin, App Store Admin. No Provisioning tile.
checks_verified.admin_sidebar: PASS - side-user-management, side-app-store, side-reporting, side-tap-admin, side-app-store-admin present. No side-provisioning, no 'Build Files' text.
checks_verified.provisioning_route_removed: PASS - Direct navigation to /admin/provisioning redirects (dev user was redirected to /dashboard); no Provisioning page renders.
checks_verified.appstore_public: PASS - dark Deep Space theme, 'orbit' wordmark, 'Powered by Orbit' + 'Robi' footer text, support@orbit.app present, no 'BDapps' text.
checks_verified.global_brand_check: PASS - No BDapps/BDApps/Provisioning/Pro App Builder text on any tested page (dashboard, digital, my-apps, reports, add-ons, admin, appstore).
checks_verified.console_errors: PASS - 0 red console errors across all pages tested.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: On Digital, a 'Welcome to Orbit Builder' tour dialog auto-opens on first visit and captures pointer events, blocking sidebar navigation until dismissed. Not a bug (intentional onboarding) but consider making it dismissible on outside-click or adding data-testid to the Skip/Close button for automation.
Nice-to-have: Add a keyboard-accessible 'Skip tour' button on the welcome modal.
test_credentials: developer@orbit.app / dev123 and admin@orbit.app / admin123 both work as expected.
seed_data_creation: None - all data mocked via localStorage as intended.
